title: [review] provisioning.py:591: provision_node does not w
description: The provision_node method docstring claims it 'Verifies the ACK' (step 4), but after sending the encrypted seed via await send_message(encrypted.encode()), it immediately returns seed without calling await receive_message() to get the ACK or br_session.decrypt_ack() to verify it. This breaks the documented security contract - the BR believes provisioning succeeded without confirmation the node received and derived the correct identity.
close_reason: Fixed: provision_node now waits for and verifies the ACK from the node. Added await receive_message() to get the ACK, and br_session.decrypt_ack() to verify the node derived the correct pubkey per spec 8.7. Updated test to simulate the node ACK response.
